diagnostic_tail: Dopamine cluster publisher error: Dopamine cluster draft rejected: The support-range section is incomplete and misleading: it states that A12/A13 support runs through iOS 18.7.1 but omits the separately documented iOS 26.0 through 26.0.1 range for A12 and A13. Because the section is presented as current Dopamine 3 support ranges, the omission fails to preserve the supplied facts.; The social post is truncated and ends with the fragment “For device and iOS compatibility,” making the deliverable incomplete.; The article adds an unsupported implication that compatibility should not be inferred from a package being listed in a package manager. The supplied facts identify Sileo and Zebra as associated package managers but do not state this package-listing rule.; The statement that tweaks may depend on “filesystem locations affected by the rootless model” expands beyond the supplied wording, which only says that rootless limits writes to certain filesystem areas and that tweaks may need updates or recompilation.; A12/A13 support is presented only through iOS 18.7.1, omitting the supplied iOS 26.0–26.0.1 range.; Compatibility cannot be inferred from a package being listed in a package manager.; A package may depend on filesystem locations affected by the rootless model.
